verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a local, stateless document-conversion CLI and library. It never holds or locks in a user's data, so 'export all my data and leave' is a category error for this kind of product. Its format-conversion abilities convert the user's own files; they are not an export-and-exit capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
